Nederlands

Topbestemmingen in Zuid-Korea

Duidelijke treingidsen, haalbare dagroutes, eerlijke wijktips en een volledig overzicht van alle 3,651 steden en gemeenten in Zuid-Korea.

Seoul · 4–6 days

Seoul (서울)

Joseon royal palaces, hanok lanes, 24-hour night markets, K-culture and mountain fortress trails.

Busan · 3–4 days

Busan (부산)

Coastal boardwalks, Haeundae & Gwangalli beaches, cliffside temples and Jagalchi seafood market.

Jeju Province · 3–5 days

Jeju Island (제주도)

Volcanic craters, Hallasan mountain trails, waterfalls, haenyeo divers and coastal cafés.

North Gyeongsang · 2–3 days

Gyeongju (경주)

The 'museum without walls': ancient Silla royal burial mounds, Bulguksa Temple and Hwangnidan-gil.

North Jeolla · 1–2 days

Jeonju (전주)

Over 700 traditional hanok houses, the birthplace of bibimbap, and lively makgeolli alleys.

Incheon · 1–2 days

Incheon & Songdo (인천)

Futuristic Songdo Central Park, historic Chinatown, Wolmido boardwalk and West Sea islands.

Gangwon Province · 2–3 days

Sokcho & Seoraksan (속초·설악산)

Granite peaks of Seoraksan National Park, East Sea beaches and Sokcho fish market.

Gangwon Province · 1–2 days

Gangneung (강릉)

East coast pine beaches, Ojukheon heritage house, Chodang tofu village and Anmok coffee street.

Gyeonggi Province · 1 day

Suwon (수원)

UNESCO-listed Hwaseong Fortress walls, Haenggung-dong cafés and famous Suwon Wang Galbi.

North Gyeongsang · 1–2 days

Andong (안동)

UNESCO Hahoe Folk Village, Confucian academies (Seowon), mask dance heritage and jjimdak.

South Jeolla · 2–3 days

Yeosu & Suncheon (여수·순천)

Romantic night sea cable car, Odongdo camellia island and Suncheonman Bay wetlands.

Daegu · 1–2 days

Daegu (대구)

Seomun Night Market, Yangnyeongsi herbal medicine alleys, Kim Gwang-seok street and Palgongsan.
